desc: Close-up shot of a man and a woman in a dimly lit bedroom at night. The woman is climbing onto his chest, burying her face affectionately against his jaw, while his large hands securely support her lower back. Soft, warm amber light casting deep shadows, intimate and emotionally overwhelming atmosphere.
